title: de.hubtask.work.bucket.created.v1
description: A column was added to a collection's board. Single-value enums stand in for `const`, and the bounds of a value are stated in its description rather than as keywords: the contract test validates against this file with the subset of JSON Schema the project implements, and a keyword it silently ignored would be a promise nobody checks. The wire format is a CloudEvent 1.0 in structured JSON (ADR-0007); the tenant, the actor and the causal chain travel as CloudEvents extension attributes, whose names are lower case without separators as the specification requires. Fields may be added; removing or reinterpreting one requires a .v2 delivered alongside .v1 for at least two minor releases (domain-model.md §4).

id.description: UUIDv7. Stable across delivery attempts, so a consumer deduplicates on it (at-least-once delivery).

source.description: The installation and the bounded context that produced the event.

subject.description: What the event is about, so that a consumer can filter without parsing the payload.

actorid.description: Absent when the system itself acts. No label: an event leaves the installation, and a name is personal data a subscriber does not need in order to react (ADR-0018).

onbehalfof.description: The principal an automation rule or an agent runs as.

correlationid.description: Everything that came out of one original action carries the same value. A root event is its own correlation.

causationid.description: The event that caused this one. Absent for an action a person took.

causationdepth.description: Distance from the original action. The rule engine stops at 5 and marks the run ABORTED_LOOP (automation.md §2).

data.description: A snapshot of the bucket as it was created. A consumer that had to fetch it would produce one request per event and read a state that has already moved on.

collection_id.description: The collection whose board this column belongs to. A bucket sits on exactly one board.

name.description: At most 120 characters, on one line, unique in the collection without regard to case or accents.

order_key.description: The rank on the board: a fractional index, not a number (offline-sync.md §4.2).

wip_limit.description: How many entries the people using this board agreed to have in the column at once, or null for no limit. Advisory: nothing refuses the drop that exceeds it.

color_token.description: A theme token rather than a colour value, so that a client can render it in its own palette.

deleted_at.description: When the column was taken off the board. Null on a live one; a bucket is deleted softly, so that a change log entry can still name it.
